description: This file defines a custom memory zone for Darwin (OS X) using jemalloc, including struct definitions, function implementations for memory management, zone registration, and promotion logic.

methods.name: zone_size
methods.description: Returns the size of the allocated block, checking ownership.

methods.name: zone_valloc
methods.description: Allocates memory aligned to page size.

methods.name: zone_free
methods.description: Frees memory, using jemalloc if owned.

methods.name: zone_realloc
methods.description: Reallocates memory, using jemalloc if owned.

methods.name: zone_good_size
methods.description: Returns a size aligned to internal size class.

methods.name: zone_force_unlock
methods.description: Unlocks the zone, handling threading and forking.

methods.name: zone_reinit_lock
methods.description: Reinitializes zone lock, used in forking.

methods.name: zone_default_get
methods.description: Retrieves the default zone, considering OSX specifics.

methods.name: zone_promote
methods.description: Unregisters and re-registers zones to promote jemalloc as default.

methods.name: zone_register
methods.description: Registers the custom jemalloc zone and promotes it to default.
